headline: Names the Bevier, Missouri post office at 108 North Macon Street after Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Bevier, Missouri, located at 108 North Macon Street. The building will be called the "SO2 Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith Post Office." It is a commemorative designation and does not change how the post office operates.
